facts.fact: Articles 30 and 31 of Law No. 005 of 2023 bar a data controller from transferring personal data outside Somalia unless the recipient country, organisation or sector gives adequate protection, the recipient is bound by a law, binding corporate rules or contractual clauses giving it, or a stated exception such as the person's consent or a contract applies; the law takes effect on adoption by Parliament, promulgation by the President and publication in the Official Bulletin, and the document's date is the presidential signature date, taken as a proxy.
facts.system: Data Protection Act (Law No. 005 of 2023), Articles 30-31

note: Text of the law; states a rule on transfers (Arts 30-31) but no published list, model terms, forms or application; Art 30(4) only says the Authority may issue them.
